headline: H.Res. 878 would have created a House select committee to investigate the resignation of the House Chaplain, but the House tabled it in 2018 and it did not pass.
what_it_does: If adopted, this resolution would have set up a select committee to look into the circumstances surrounding the resignation of Father Patrick Conroy, the Chaplain of the House of Representatives. The title describes it as a question of the privileges of the House, which is a procedural way a member can bring an issue to the floor. The House instead voted on May 8, 2018 to table the measure, which ended it without a committee investigation.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the House of Representatives
who_it_affects.how: If adopted, members would have been asked to serve on or oversee a select committee examining the chaplain's resignation.
